interpretation: The single original GitHub-hosted Windows tools job passed the locked release build and strict release clippy of the existing media-codec examples. This receipt records build provenance only.

The official ZIP digest, size, run and exact source match. All 169 extracted files have independent actual-byte hashes, and all 168 outer producer receipt entries independently match, including five executable files and original license/notice files.

The nested nestlink-codecs.json files/libraries describe 111 supplier native build inputs and archive paths whose bytes are not included in this bundle. That nested inventory is preserved as supplier provenance and is not counted as independent native archive or header verification.

target_execution_performed is false. These finite diagnostic tools use synthetic input and preserve their original directions, deadlines, accepted-output counts, SPS/color/geometry and cleanup gates. They do not establish HDR capture, physical scanout, sustained cadence, live product integration, whole-media acceptance or release eligibility.

The separate windows-hdr10-direction-probe.exe is present in this exact-source bundle; historical SDR/Main10 and earlier target failures remain unchanged. Any subsequent authorized target run must record its own ordinary interactive token, executable digests, exact arguments, stdout/stderr and failure results.
